notes.title: Major Bullet now supports gamepad controls
notes.notes:
We're happy to announce that you can now play Major Bullet using a gamepad!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44866860/1d9c0659c1183322aeb4fd5e612ebf35e775800c.png[/img]

The LBG team is working to improve the control scheme and we would welcome player feedback and suggestions for improving the controls in the game!
You can leave your comment under this news or take part in a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2802210/view/4147332104860988388]CONVERSATION[/url] with the developers!

notes.title: The DEMO version is now available!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44866860/65695824d587c52faaaa8a2e6c9e3149b9d11b18.png[/img]

Feel like a Bullet in a city populated by living objects, where weapons are outlawed, and the likes of you are chased by the police. Because each of you poses a danger to society. But is that really the case?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44866860/3852a081a15c63795be8a498cd64d3cc36642830.png[/img]

You will have to follow in the footsteps of Colonel Goose – the only living creature for hundreds of miles around – to figure out what really stands behind the banishment of your brethren.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44866860/b76b64df5e1c308052166c2ae7e9f6acd3b4c439.png[/img]
Your adventure starts right now!
